text:
Alex: Heads-up: new POC request from 'Helix Care' — 14-day POC for convo routing + automated case summaries. They want SLOs, blockers (KMS/VPC), and rough burn.
Sara: What's expected throughput? that'll determine Dedicated vs hosted.
Alex: Baseline 50 reqs/min, short spikes to 150. Avg convo ~500 tokens. Target: routing p95 <400ms, summary p95 <800ms.
Maya: Security: require customer KMS, EU-only data residency, SIEM integration. Can POC run in their VPC? @Tim
Tim: Yes. We can provision Dedicated in eu-west-1, use customer KMS, forward logs to their SIEM, and disable persistent KV cache for POC.
Alex: Proposed acceptance gates:
- Routing accuracy >= 90% on 400 labeled chats
- Summaries: human agreement >= 85% on 150 samples OR ROUGE-L >= 0.60
- Latency: routing p95 <=400ms, summarization p95 <=800ms under normal load
- Cost: <= $0.02 per 1k input tokens (POC estimate)
- Reliability: fallback to quantized model if errors >1% or latency >900ms for 5m
Sara: Sample prompt for eval harness?
Alex: "You are a concise case summarizer. Return JSON: {summary, action_items} given the conversation."
Maya: Confirm no persistent storage of PII unless customer opts in and that KMS controls any stored blobs.
Tim: Confirmed. Transient sessions, no KV caching, all at-rest encrypted via customer KMS. Redaction pipeline available.
Sara: Rough cost calc: 7.2M tokens/day (12k conv/day *600) -> at $0.02/1k = $144/day -> ~$2k for 14d plus infra. Quantized model can cut compute by ~25%.
Alex: Runbook owners: I'll draft runbook; Sara owns eval metrics; Tim owns infra and deploy config.
Tim: deploy-bot: Reserved Dedicated (2xA10G) eu-west-1 for 2026-05-03 08:00 UTC -> 2026-05-17 08:00 UTC. I'll include a small deploy snippet and a 3-hr load test on day 2.
Alex: Next: send SOW, finish security answers, finalize thresholds with customer by EOD tomorrow. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
